limitations: One local run verified graph execution and output structure; effect quality, preservation quality, temporal consistency, minimum hardware and platform compatibility remain unqualified.

Output frame rate follows the decoded source video; frames are rescaled to about 0.4 megapixels with sides divisible by 16, and only the first 81 frames are restyled (Wan VACE 1.3B limits). No FPS, duration, timeline, or segment control exists in this recipe.
The person reference is the first fitted source frame, so a clip that starts without the subject cannot keep a subject it never shows.
Edge conditioning follows visible contours and can prevent intended clothing or geometry changes.
Mute only: source audio is not carried into the output.
VACE dependency and weight license audit is incomplete; see docs/EFFECTS-FINISHING.md.
